mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bill (type, category_id, price, remark, date) VALUES (#{bill.type}, #{bill.categoryId}, #{bill.price}, #{bill.remark}, #{bill.date})
mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.type, b.price, b.remark, b.date, c.id AS category_id, c.type AS category_type, c.title AS category_title, c.icon AS category_icon FROM bill b INNER JOIN bill_user bu ON b.id = bu.bill_id AND bu.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE bu.u_id = #{uId} AND b.date >= #{start} AND b.date < #{end} AND b.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY b.date DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE bill SET type = #{bill.type}, category_id = #{bill.categoryId}, price = #{bill.price}, date = #{bill.date}, remark = #{bill.remark} WHERE id = #{bill.id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE bill SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id in #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
